description.narrative: Multicountry EECA IHAU, TB/HIV, International Charitable Foundation “Alliance for Public Health” (Alliance for Public Health)This program has the following goals: Develop models of sustainable city responses to HIV and TB in key populations in EECA that significantly contribute to achieving 90-90-90 HIV/TB targets for key populations. The objectives of this program are: Objective 1: Development and implementation of a model for key populations for the '90-90-90’ targets of the HIV and TB response in selected cities of the EECA region. Objective 2: Establishing effective partnerships between municipalities and NGOs/CSOs in selected EECA cities. Objective 3: Ensuring sustainable allocations of municipal funding for key population programs in project cities. Objective 4: To increase knowledge management and popularize city responses on HIV and TB in cities of the EECA region and globally
